visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A chef wearing a black patterned bandana, black mask, and white t-shirt stands in a stainless steel kitchen, using a spatula to stir-fry food over a large flame in a wok. (2) The scene shifts to several black bowls of Japanese donburi (rice bowls) arranged on a tray, featuring toppings like pork cutlets, eggs, and green onions. (3) A white mug containing Hokkaido soup curry with broccoli and baby corn is shown, with more soup being poured into it. (4) A close-up of a piece of fried chicken with Mentai sauce in a small bamboo basket. (5) A bowl of white rice is held up. (6) A pair of chopsticks lifts a piece of thick, fried pork cutlet covered in runny egg and green onions. (7) A beef rice bowl with a raw egg yolk in the center is stirred, followed by a close-up of thinly sliced beef being lifted. (8) On a hot iron plate, a mountain of rice shaped like Mt. Fuji with a raw egg yolk on top is surrounded by beef and green onions; red curry sauce is poured around the base. (9) A close-up of a spoon lifting rice mixed with the red sauce and egg yolk. (10) A dessert consisting of a black pudding topped with green matcha ice cream is sliced with a knife. (11) The camera pans through the interior of the restaurant, showing counter seating with individual partitions and menu posters on the walls. (12) The video ends with a text overlay listing store addresses and a shot of the restaurant's storefront with brand logos.
